title: Opening Surface IFC Generator
description: Builds a self-contained IFC4X3 model of watertight opening closed surfaces from the opening_surface node, placed into the source model's spatial structure.
markdownDescription:
The `opening_surface_ifc_generator` node builds a self-contained IFC4X3 model in
which each opening closed surface retrieved by the `opening_surface` node becomes
one `IfcBuildingElementProxy`.

## How it works

For each opening, the cached volume mesh is resolved and its planar face groups
are flattened into polygonal faces of one `IfcPolygonalFaceSet` per group, written
as the Body of a single `IfcBuildingElementProxy`. Each opening is one element.

The project/site/building/storey skeleton is replicated from every source model,
and each proxy is contained in the new storey that mirrors the storey holding its
host element. The opening closed surface is written as an `IfcQuantityVolume` and
the opening area as an `IfcQuantityArea`.

## Inputs

- **Openings** (required): the opening results of the `opening_surface` node. Bind
  its `openings` output here. This must be bound to real geometry; an unbound
  required input fails the node.
- **Output filename** (settings): the name of the generated IFC file, written into
  the workflow output directory.

## Outputs

- `output_path`: absolute path of the generated IFC file
- `element_count`: number of generated proxies
- `storey_count`: number of building storeys replicated from the source model
- `elements`: ordered list with one entry per opening:
  - `opening_ref`: the source opening's qualified reference
  - `element_guid`: GlobalId of the generated proxy
  - `face_count`: number of polygonal faces written
  - `method`: how the source closed surface was derived
  - `volume`: the volume in cubic metres (`IfcQuantityVolume`)
  - `host_ref` / `storey_ref`: source host and storey references
  - `area`: the opening area (`IfcQuantityArea`)
  - `error`: reason when the proxy could not be generated

## Notes and limitations

- A proxy is generated for every opening that has cached geometry. Openings
  without geometry are reported with an error entry instead and count toward
  `element_count` only when they have an error.
- The proxy is written at the world origin; its geometry carries the absolute
  coordinates of the opening closed surface from the source model.

de.title: Öffnungsflächen-IFC-Generator
de.description: Erstellt ein eigenständiges IFC4X3-Modell aus den wasserdichten geschlossenen Öffnungsoberflächen des opening_surface-Nodes und ordnet es der räumlichen Struktur des Quellmodells zu.
de.markdownDescription:
Der `opening_surface_ifc_generator`-Node erstellt ein eigenständiges IFC4X3-Modell,
in dem jede vom `opening_surface`-Node ermittelte geschlossene
Öffnungsoberfläche zu einem `IfcBuildingElementProxy` wird.

## Funktionsweise

Für jede Öffnung wird das zwischengespeicherte Netz der geschlossenen Oberfläche
aufgelöst und seine ebenen Flächengruppen werden zu polygonalen Flächen einer
`IfcPolygonalFaceSet` pro Gruppe abgeflacht und als Body eines einzelnen
`IfcBuildingElementProxy` geschrieben. Jede Öffnung ist ein Element.

Das Projekt-/Gelände-/Gebäude-/Geschossgerüst wird aus jedem Quellmodell
übernommen, und jeder Proxy wird in das neue Geschoss eingeordnet, das das
Geschoss seines Bauteils spiegelt. Die geschlossene Öffnungsoberfläche wird als
`IfcQuantityVolume` und die Öffnungsfläche als `IfcQuantityArea` geschrieben.

## Eingänge

- **Öffnungen** (erforderlich): die Öffnungsergebnisse des `opening_surface`-Nodes.
  Binden Sie hier dessen `openings`-Ausgang an. Dies muss an echte Geometrie
  gebunden sein; ein ungebundener Pflichteingang lässt den Node fehlschlagen.
- **Ausgabedateiname** (Einstellungen): der Name der erzeugten IFC-Datei, die in
  das Workflow-Ausgabeverzeichnis geschrieben wird.

## Ausgaben

- `output_path`: absoluter Pfad der erzeugten IFC-Datei
- `element_count`: Anzahl der erzeugten Proxys
- `storey_count`: Anzahl der aus dem Quellmodell übernommenen Geschosse
- `elements`: geordnete Liste mit einem Eintrag pro Öffnung:
  - `opening_ref`: qualifizierte Referenz der Quellöffnung
  - `element_guid`: GlobalId des erzeugten Proxys
  - `face_count`: Anzahl der geschriebenen polygonalen Flächen
  - `method`: wie die geschlossene Quelloberfläche ermittelt wurde
  - `volume`: das Volumen in Kubikmetern (`IfcQuantityVolume`)
  - `host_ref` / `storey_ref`: Referenzen von Quellbauteil und -geschoss
  - `area`: die Öffnungsfläche (`IfcQuantityArea`)
  - `error`: Grund, wenn der Proxy nicht erzeugt werden konnte

## Hinweise und Grenzen

- Für jede Öffnung mit zwischengespeicherter Geometrie wird ein Proxy erzeugt.
  Öffnungen ohne Geometrie werden stattdessen als Fehlereintrag gemeldet.
- Der Proxy wird am Weltursprung geschrieben; seine Geometrie trägt die absoluten
  Koordinaten der geschlossenen Öffnungsoberfläche aus dem Quellmodell.

output_filename.description: Name of the generated IFC file. Written into the workflow output directory (the folder containing the workflow file).
output_filename.title: Output filename

output_path.description: Absolute path of the generated IFC file.
output_path.title: Output path

element_count.description: Number of generated opening closed-surface proxies.
element_count.title: Element count

storey_count.description: Number of building storeys replicated from the source model.
storey_count.title: Storey count

elements.description: Ordered list of generated proxies with their spatial relation.

opening_ref.description: Qualified reference of the source opening (`<slug>:expr:<id>`).
opening_ref.title: Opening reference

face_count.description: Number of polygonal faces written for this opening closed surface.
face_count.title: Face count

method.description: How the source closed surface was derived: 'closed_cut_surface', 'lofted_caps' or 'caps_only'.
method.title: Method

volume.description: Volume of the opening solid written as an IfcQuantityVolume, in cubic metres, or None when it could not be retrieved.
volume.title: Volume

host_ref.description: Qualified reference of the host element the opening voids.
host_ref.title: Host reference

storey_ref.description: Qualified reference of the source building storey the proxy was contained in, or None when the host is not inside a storey.
storey_ref.title: Storey reference

area.description: Opening area written as an IfcQuantityArea on the proxy.
area.title: Area

error.description: Error reason when the proxy could not be generated.
error.title: Error

elements.title: Elements

openings.description: Opening closed-surface results of the opening_surface node. Bind its 'openings' output here.

guid.description: GlobalId of the opening element, empty when missing.
guid.title: GUID

host_express_id.description: Qualified reference of the host element the opening voids.
host_express_id.title: Host express ID

geometry_key.description: Geometry-cache key (`gen:`) of the retrieved opening closed surface, or None when it could not be retrieved.
geometry_key.title: Geometry key

method.description: How the closed surface was derived: 'closed_cut_surface' (a through-bore whose cut-surface tube closed watertight), 'lofted_caps' (the two cap faces were lofted/connected, possibly with a synthesized second cap), or 'caps_only' (no watertight closed surface; the cap/tube geometry is emitted unchanged).
method.title: Method

watertight.description: Whether the emitted geometry is a closed, winding-consistent, positive-volume solid.
watertight.title: Watertight

area.description: Opening area in the plane of the host surface (the larger cap face), or None when it could not be retrieved.
area.title: Area

width.description: Horizontal extent of the opening in the host plane, or None when it could not be retrieved.
width.title: Width

height.description: Vertical extent of the opening in the host plane, or None when it could not be retrieved.
height.title: Height

depth.description: Distance between the two cap faces along the host surface normal. None when only one cap face exists or it could not be retrieved.
depth.title: Depth

error.description: Error reason when the opening closed surface could not be retrieved.
error.title: Error

openings.title: Openings
